description.narrative: The Montreal Protocol aims to eliminate ozone-depleting substances (ODS), with financial and technical support provided to developing countries, including those under Article 5 (A-5), to facilitate this transition. The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) assists these nations in implementing phase-out projects. Lebanon, having completed initial phases of its HCFC phase-out management plan (HPMP) and ratified the Kigali Amendment, is preparing for Stage I of its Kigali Implementation Plan (KIP) to phase down HFCs. The Project Implementation Plan for KIP Stage I has been approved, and additional funding is being requested to support data collection and strategy development for the HFC use in Lebanons manufacturing sector, particularly among SMEs in commercial refrigeration, to ensure effective phase-down.
